# Treat reasoning models as first-class, and stream them

## Context

Scoping LFM2.5-2.6B as the signed-out / free-mode engine turned up a
structural assumption: the codebase treats reasoning output as a defect to be
recovered from, not a mode to be supported.

Three sites discard the whole generation and call again whenever the reply
contains a `<think>` block — not when the reply is unusable, merely when the
channel was touched. LFM2.5's chat template *always* opens `<think>`, so every
note would silently cost two calls on the slowest engine in the product. The
retry even instructs the model "do not place your whole answer inside `<think>`
tags," which that model cannot obey.

Streaming has the matching gap. The server persona path doesn't stream at all,
and the client streams only visible prose — so a model that thinks first shows
a blank panel for many seconds, because the persona card is filtered on
non-empty text.

The outcome we want: reasoning is an expected mode, never a reason to
regenerate; every persona note streams from both client and server; and the
reader sees the room start thinking immediately, with the option to watch it.

Most of the machinery already exists and is simply unwired — see Change 2.

## Change 1 — Reasoning is expected, not a defect

Three sites, same shape:
`src/utils/ai-client.ts:759`, `convex/agents.ts:309`, `convex/agents.ts:409`.

- Condition `if (!visible || hasReasoningTags(text))` becomes `if (!visible)`.
  Regenerate only when nothing visible survived stripping — a truncated or
  unclosed block — never merely because the model reasoned.
- Change the retry nudge to something obeyable: "Close your `<think>` block,
  then write the note." When the second attempt is also empty, keep the
  existing `removeReasoningTagMarkers` salvage.
- Rewrite the `hasReasoningTags` doc comment (`src/utils/reasoning-tags.ts:5-13`)
  — it currently documents the discard policy as the intent, and would
  otherwise re-teach the removed behaviour to the next reader.

Everything else that calls `stripReasoningTags` (llm-parsing, research-targets,
the judge paths) is already correct and needs no change.

## Change 2 — Use the accumulator that already exists

`src/utils/generation-stream.ts` already implements exactly what's needed:
native `reasoning-delta` parts *and* inline `<think>` tags, independent text
and reasoning lifecycles, and an `activePart` telling a view which is
receiving deltas. It has **zero imports and no test** — fully built, never
wired up. Press it into service rather than writing anything new.

Leave `src/utils/interview-stream.ts` alone. It layers DOSSIER/PROBE contract
masking over the same idea; folding the two together is a separate change.

## Change 3 — Client streaming becomes reasoning-aware

- `runOnce` (`src/utils/ai-client.ts:648-694`) consumes `result.fullStream`
  instead of `result.textStream`, feeding `createGenerationStreamAccumulator`.
  Native reasoning parts stop being invisible; `createVisibleTextFilter` is
  replaced by the accumulator.
- Widen `StreamText` (`src/utils/ai-client.ts:634`) from
  `(visibleSoFar: string) => void` to `(snapshot: GenerationStreamSnapshot) => void`.
- Update call sites that assign `store.streamingNotes[id] = partial` —
  `personas-panel.tsx` (three, near :678, :982, :1288), `comments-panel.tsx:385`,

  routed through it.

  `dossierInterviewStreams` (`convex/schema.ts:18-32`).
- `convex/personaNoteStreams.ts`: new, mirroring `convex/interviewStreams.ts` —
  `get` query, `write` internalMutation, `clear` mutation, same
  `authenticatedUserId` guard.
- `runLlm` (`convex/agents.ts:274-376`) takes an optional `streamId`. When

  `convex/agents.ts:803-828`, writing snapshots through the new mutation.

- `src/utils/generation-stream.test.ts` — new. Cover native reasoning parts,

- `src/utils/ai-client.test.ts` — assert **no** second call when reasoning tags

Run these files individually — the full suite has pre-existing cross-file
interference unrelated to this change.

   this whole change exists to fix.
3. Run the app against a reasoning model and watch a persona note: the card
   should appear immediately in a thinking state, the disclosure should hold
   the reasoning, and prose should stream in without the panel blanking.
